body: Source candidate463922c pushed on wp/B5-16 for d20e6e9b. Only filters.rs product helpers/evaluator/tests changed, plus handoff docs; RequestCancellation struct/accessor untouched. Private FilterEvalError Cancelled/Failed(BridgeError) through Spec::run/run_effect/block channel/eval_stack; native caller into_engine, cached-prefix caller into_bridge. Same live effect/native pair. Production collector drains all results, first observed real failure wins cancellation in either order, no image returned on partial failure; scheduling unchanged. Six tiny tests UNRUN cover real Gaussian/empty precancel, native legacy typed cancellation, collector orders/drain/partial output, gated genuine error race, malformed mask and compatibility/invalid controls. Rustfmt/diff-check passed only. Notes tools/orchestrate/wp/B5-16/LEGACY-EFFECT-TYPED-IMPLEMENTATION.md; A should retain preview/bake and cached-prefix/integration regression gates. No builds/tests/apps/bindings/benchmark/heartbeat restart on B. No compositor/PSD/IO/document/Swift/shell/generated edits. A owns compilation and main; editing-readiness smoke remains independent.
